notes.title: LIMINAL UNIVERSE UPDATE
notes.content:
Changes made with the update:
-Options for sounds in the Settings section have been increased.
-Some effects were adjusted based on user feedback.
-Controller stats were added.
-The lock system in the cassette system has been removed.
-Lighting has been adjusted.
-Some UVs have been reworked, and the issues related to the mentioned dip problem have been fixed.
